title: More places to chat with Pollinations
summary:
Chat gained new homes, Qwen gained a checkpoint, and community model publishing lost nine hours of waiting.

A hosted Open WebUI app was added with Pollinations login and chats billed to each user's Pollen wallet; it also joined the app catalog. A community-built Discord adapter lets people connect their own Pollinations access to OSAII Swarm and ask it questions. AI Homework Solver joined the learn catalog, while agent tool-result formatting was adjusted so Open WebUI can render it cleanly.

Paid-only `qwen/qwen3.8-max-0902` was added for Chat Completions and Responses, with text, image, and video input. New fallback routes cover Qwen3.7 Flash, Mistral Small 3.2, Wan 2.2 Turbo, and GPT Image models; Llama Scout's fallback moved to Vertex. Cached timestamped speech now retains its format and voice headers. The README was refreshed with recent API, model, and video updates.

Model filters moved into editable search tokens, with separate URL-backed searches for Models, Agents, and MCP. The community publishing and endpoint-change delay dropped from 12 hours to 3 hours. Community model metadata now drives leaderboard, monitor, and CLI distinctions; model-list responses expose more catalog fields, and the Model Monitor layout works better on narrow screens.

highlights.title: Pollinations in Open WebUI
highlights.text: Chat with Pollinations models in a hosted Open WebUI using Pollinations login. Usage comes from your Pollen wallet.

highlights.title: OSAII Swarm meets Discord
highlights.text: Connect your own Pollinations access to the community-built OSAII Swarm Discord adapter, then ask the agent questions with `/ask`.

highlights.title: Qwen3.8 Max 0902
highlights.text: Use paid-only `qwen/qwen3.8-max-0902` with text, image, or video input through Chat Completions or Responses. It supports tools, reasoning, and a 1-million-token context window. [View the model](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models?q=qwen/qwen3.8-max-0902).

highlights.title: Search with filter tokens
highlights.text: Filter models directly in the search field, switch between official and community sources, and keep separate searches for Models, Agents, and MCP. [Browse models](https://enter.pollinations.ai/models).

highlights.title: OpenClaw setup through polli
highlights.text: Use `polli harness openclaw on|off|status` to configure OpenClaw with a catalog-validated text model and the Polli skill for image, audio, and video generation. [Get the CLI](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@pollinations/cli).

highlights.title: Shorter community publishing wait
highlights.text: The wait for publishing community models and endpoint agents, along with related public endpoint changes, is down from 12 hours to 3 hours.
